properties.name: idkit.backend
properties.description: Lease backend: jdbc or redis.

properties.name: idkit.worker-count
properties.description: Number of worker IDs available for allocation.

properties.name: idkit.datacenter-id
properties.description: Datacenter ID embedded in generated IDs.

properties.name: idkit.owner
properties.description: Unique owner name for the worker lease.

properties.name: idkit.lease-ttl
properties.description: Worker lease TTL.

properties.name: idkit.heartbeat-failure-threshold
properties.description: Consecutive heartbeat failures before invalidating the lease.

properties.name: idkit.acquisition-attempts
properties.description: Maximum lease acquisition attempts during startup.

properties.name: idkit.acquisition-retry-delay
properties.description: Delay between lease acquisition attempts.

properties.name: idkit.recovery.enabled
properties.description: Automatically reacquire a lease and rebuild the generator after lease loss.

properties.name: idkit.recovery.retry-delay
properties.description: Delay between lease recovery attempts.

properties.name: idkit.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enable Micrometer lease metrics when MeterRegistry is available.

properties.name: idkit.metrics.prefix
properties.description: Micrometer metric name prefix.

properties.name: idkit.health.enabled
properties.description: Expose lease state through Actuator health.

properties.name: idkit.generator.type
properties.description: Generator type: snowflake or flake.

properties.name: idkit.generator.timestamp-bits
properties.description: Timestamp bit count for a custom flake layout.

properties.name: idkit.generator.datacenter-id-bits
properties.description: Datacenter bit count for a custom flake layout.

properties.name: idkit.generator.worker-id-bits
properties.description: Worker bit count for a custom flake layout.

properties.name: idkit.generator.timestamp-divisor
properties.description: Timestamp resolution divisor.

properties.name: idkit.generator.epoch
properties.description: Custom generator epoch.

properties.name: idkit.generator.clock-regression-tolerance
properties.description: Clock regression tolerance.

properties.name: idkit.jdbc.auto-initialize
properties.description: Create the JDBC lease table and worker rows at startup.

properties.name: idkit.jdbc.validate-schema
properties.description: Validate the JDBC lease table, fencing column, and worker rows at startup without changing schema.

properties.name: idkit.jdbc.dialect
properties.description: JDBC dialect.

properties.name: idkit.jdbc.table-name
properties.description: JDBC lease table name.

properties.name: idkit.redis.uri
properties.description: Redis URI.

properties.name: idkit.redis.key-prefix
properties.description: Redis key prefix.
